brief:
Saja el-Khawas, a Palestinian-British child aged six, died several days after her mother, father, and sister drowned off the coast of the United Kingdom, Al Jazeera English reported. The family of four perished in the incident that occurred on Tuesday.

The girl's death marks the final loss in what authorities are investigating as a single drowning event. Details surrounding the circumstances of the family's death in UK waters remain under investigation.
dek: Saja el-Khawas's death follows that of her mother, father and sister on Tuesday, all of whom drowned.
title: Six-year-old Palestinian girl dies days after family drowns off UK coast
